correctness.rationale: The polynomial identity proves the point and discriminant exactly in F5[t]. At t=0 and t=3 the section meets exceptional nonidentity components of III and IV; at infinity it passes through the I5 Weierstrass node. Height positivity selects the extreme I5 correction and gives 1/30. Rational-surface NS determinant and Shioda--Tate give rank 1, and the determinant formula forces both torsion order and the index of P to be one. The explicit alpha^5=-alpha identity gives Frobenius -1 and all constant-field fixed subgroups. The embedded exact checker passed; the infinite conclusions rely on the supplied proof, not finite testing.

value.rationale: This identifies, with coordinates and no missing sections, the arithmetic Mordell--Weil group and minimal constant field of definition of a natural positive-characteristic rational elliptic surface used in a recent Calabi--Yau construction. Complete descent across all finite constant fields and its quadratic twist distinguishes a surface with no nonzero F5(t)-sections from its rank-one quadratic extension. It is a natural arithmetic invariant, more specific than the already-known abstract geometric rank and genuinely useful for arithmetic sections and twists of fiber-product constructions.
